description: Read the rules this team's company brain is built on — how pages are typed and templated, when to create one versus extend one, and the link format. Read it BEFORE your first write to a workspace's wiki. It is the same text the nightly ingest job runs on, so a page you write matches the ones Monnet writes; a team that has rewritten it for their own brain is exactly the case where guessing goes wrong.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: get_wiki_schema
